title: Radisson Hotel Group brings hotel discovery into ChatGPT
summary: Radisson partnered with Accenture to build a ChatGPT plugin using OpenAI technology, helping travelers find, compare, and book hotels while planning their trips.
reason: Item reports a partnership (Radisson with Accenture) building a ChatGPT plugin using OpenAI technology, a non-model product integration, announced on OpenAI's own site. This is an AI industry business event (partnership/product launch) covered by rule 3-1.
